name: Michael Coughlin

bio: Preacher from Ohio who loves Jesus, my wife, my kids, and my neighbors: including the preborn/voiceless.

name: Catechism of Suffering
title: Site
bio: Sixty questions and answers on affliction by Matthew Statler, pastor and ACBC-certified biblical counselor, freely given. A companion to the Suffering and Hope questions here.

name: Matthew Statler
title: Writing
bio: Pastor and ACBC-certified biblical counselor at Sierra Vista Baptist Church, Army veteran, and author of the Catechism of Suffering. He writes on how Scripture speaks to trauma, suffering, the soul and true change. The Suffering and Hope answers here draw on his work.
